system.description: When you, your programs, or your deck are about to be damaged by ICE, you can try to jack out. Roll Cool.

success.value: You disconnect yourself from the system before any serious harm occurs.

partial.value:
You jack out, but choose one:
• You lose some data
• You take some of the established consequences
• The owners of the target system trace you to your current location

failure.value: You take the established consequences... and you're still connected.
